title: Arrival / vehicle overlap
objective: Recognize an arrival and ARFF crossing using track, clearance and time evidence.

title: Crossing with time margin
objective: Distinguish a safe crossing from nominal overlap.

title: Vehicle stops on the runway
objective: Maintain occupancy when runway-clear time is unknown.

title: Vehicle holds outside protection
objective: Do not confuse permission or a request with physical occupancy.

title: Crossing without clearance
objective: Detect occupancy even when a vehicle has no crossing clearance.

title: Hold-short violation
objective: Compare observed movement to an active hold instruction.

title: Cancelled crossing, continuing movement
objective: Cancellation does not remove an object from the runway.

title: Delayed go-around response
objective: Do not assume a command immediately changes flight movement.

title: Opposite-direction runway use
objective: Map 09 and 27 to the same physical resource.

title: Tracking lost during an active threat
objective: Keep the threat and show degraded information.

title: Concurrent instructions exercise
objective: Use acknowledgement and command revisions while coordinating tower and ground.

title: Timeline and replay exercise
objective: Reconstruct events at the selected time and compare role views.
